turns.text: Oh, and we've started setting up some new end-to-end tests for the dashboard feature.
turns.zh: 哦，还有，我们已经开始为仪表盘功能搭建一些新的端到端测试了。

turns.text: Should have those ready for review by tomorrow.
turns.zh: 明天之前应该能准备好给大家评审。

turns.text: Product owner, any updates from your end?
turns.zh: 产品负责人，你那边有什么进展吗？

turns.text: Yes, just a couple of things.
I've been reviewing the user stories for our next sprint.
turns.zh: 我一直在看我们下个冲刺的用户故事。

turns.text: We might need to adjust some priorities.
turns.zh: 我们可能需要调整一些优先级。
